reviews.decision: Do not adopt the experimental M3 toolbar support into the independently owned historical M2 facade. All six complete original files and eleven hunks were individually reviewed, including the demo typography override removal, the real experimental card subtitle color-system repair, toolbar density tables, M2 aggregation and version/token dispatch. The owned card subtitle already uses its independent M2 foreground palette rather than that experimental system; the owned toolbar preserves three tagged private bodies and the existing finite public companion bridge. Eight toolbar argument cases preserve untouched16 CSS plus exactly the previously qualified companion additions. Keep historical namespaces, selectors, map semantics and legacy geometry without introducing private inspection or an experimental M3 generator. Mixed M2/M3 native coexistence and full packed/browser/floor qualification remain open.
